candidates.label: A
candidates.notes: All Japanese entries, readings, line indices (9–21, no 17) and 〔人名〕 tags match the image. Glosses are accurate throughout (e.g. まずない 'highly unlikely', かの 'that (famous)'). Minor: inconsistent full-width space before the Nixon gloss; small-type する/な/に not distinguished.

candidates.label: B
candidates.notes: Japanese text, readings and indices all correct. Glosses mostly accurate; a few slightly loose ones: 会談する 'to have a talk', 耳にする 'to overhear', まずない 'rarely'. Line-per-entry layout preserved.

candidates.label: C
candidates.notes: Japanese text, readings and indices all correct. Glosses accurate (否 'no; refusal' is acceptable; 繊維 'textiles; fiber' fine). Minor spacing inconsistency around the 〔人名〕 glosses.

candidates.label: D
candidates.notes: Japanese text and readings correct. Inserts blank lines between numbered groups that are not in the printed layout. Glosses mostly fine; 〜に応じる 'depending on' and 否 'not' are slightly off for the dictionary form; 'Nixon [proper name]' is acceptable.

candidates.label: E
candidates.notes: Japanese text, readings and indices correct. Glosses generally accurate but some are thin or oddly ordered: 口にする leads with 'to eat or drink', 否 'not', 繊維 only 'fiber', 温床 only 'hotbed'. Layout preserved.

rationale: All five candidates transcribe the Japanese terms, furigana readings, line numbers and 〔人名〕 tags identically and correctly, so the ranking rests on gloss quality and layout fidelity. A and C have the most precise and complete glosses, with A slightly ahead. B has a few looser glosses, and E has several thin or less apt ones. D is last because it adds blank-line grouping not present in the source and has a couple of slightly off glosses.
